emailConfirm_click
Part of the confirmation email upon registering for a LiXiangQi account.
The unique reset link is presented just after this string.

resources.string: Taabo dabarkan hoose si aad u furtid akoonkaaga LiXiangQi:
Cusboonaysii furahaaga lixiangqi.com, %s
Wuu na soo gaadhay codsigii cusboonaysiinta furaha akoonkaagu.
Haddii uu codsigani adiga kaa yimid, riix dabarkan hoose. Haddii kale, iska dhaaf farriintan.
Hubi cinwaankaaga cusub, %s
Waxaad codsatay beddelidda cinwaankaaga.
Si aad u caddaysid in aad cinwaankan leedahay, fadlan riix mareegtan hoose:
Ku soo dhawow lixiangqi.com, %s
Gal lixiangqi.com, %s
(Lama riixi karo? Ku day in ad laynka toos ugu qortid interneedka!)
Kani waa cinwaan adeeg oo la xidiidha isticmaalkaaga %s.
Si aad noolasoo xidhiidhid, fadlan isticmaal %s.
Akoonkaaga LiXiangQi waa diyaar. Haddii aad baranayso xeerarka ama aad ku soo noqonayso ciyaarta, waan ku faraxsanahay inaad halkan joogto.
Ciyaar xiangqi
Ciyaar ka bilow bogga hore. Ciyaartaada koowaad si deggan ugu bilow adigoo la ciyaaraya kombiyuutarka.
Isku day halxiraale
Ku tababar garashada khataraha iyo helidda dhaqdhaqaaqyada guusha. Ha degdegin: eeg digniinta boqorka, qabashada xabbadaha iyo jawaabta suuragalka ah ee kaa soo horjeeda.
Isbar dadka kale
Ku dar isbarasho kooban boggaaga shakhsiga ah si ciyaartoyda kale kuu bartaan.
Eeg boggaaga shakhsiga ah
Wax ka beddel boggaaga shakhsiga ah
Ku raaxayso ciyaartaada xigta. Waxaan ku kulmi doonnaa looxa ciyaarta!
